author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಪಂಡಿತನು ನೀನೆನುವ ಮಾಯೆಯಲಿ ಬದುಕುತಿರೆ
ಖಂಡಿಸುವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವಿನ್ನೊಬ್ಬಗಿಹುದು
ಮಂಡಿಸುವ ನಿನಶೈಲಿ ಏಕಮುಖವಾಗಿರಲು
ದಂಡನೆಗೆ ಅರ್ಹವಹು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you live in the illusion that you are a scholar,
remember someone else has the power to refute you;
when your way of presenting things is one-sided,
it deserves to be punished, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Believing ourselves learned is a trap; there is always someone who can prove us wrong. One-sided argument invites a fall.
